How the work is done

Methodology

Short, high-level summaries of the core workflows. Each is a pipeline that has been run end to end, with a control carried through so a result can be read against a benchmark.

Molecular docking

AutoDock Vina · PLIP

Prepare the receptor and ligands, place a search box over the active site, and validate by re-docking the native ligand to recover the crystal pose. Candidates are then docked and ranked by predicted binding energy, with the binding mode read from the top pose.

ADMET profiling

RDKit · pkCSM

Drug-likeness and physicochemical descriptors from the structure, then absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity endpoints predicted from the 2D graph. Read as liabilities to flag early, not as measured values.

Molecular dynamics

GROMACS · CHARMM36m / CGenFF

Minimize, equilibrate under NVT then NPT, and run production at body temperature and pressure in explicit water with physiological salt. Stability is read from ligand RMSD, minimum distance, contact count, and hydrogen-bond occupancy, always against a positive control.

Polymer analysis

GROMACS · OpenFF / CHARMM

Pack multi-chain boxes and equilibrate under NPT, then read density, radius of gyration, end-to-end distance, and diffusion from the trajectory. The force field is validated against a known polymer density before any prediction is trusted.

Molecular design · photophysics

White-light emitters

A closed-loop search for single-material white emission, built on excited-state proton transfer and dual-band emission.

Each candidate is optimized in the ground state, then checked with TD-DFT for absorption, relaxed S1 emission, and the singlet-triplet gap in ORCA. The map places 94 candidates by gap and dipole; 31 carry a full excited-state calculation. Click any point to inspect it in 3D. computational

design spaceclick a point
HBTESIPT
voxel view

The lead two-component blend reached neutral white at CIE (0.325, 0.319), 5900 K, 0.016 from the D65 point. Twisted intramolecular charge transfer was the obstruction to single-molecule white emission.

Materials & molecular engineering

MOF organic linkers

A substituent and ring-system sweep across dicarboxylate linkers, each with its own quantum-chemical fingerprint.

245 linkers across 9 ring families were optimized and characterized by DFT for energy, dipole, and polarizability. The map reads polarizability against dipole, colored by ring family. Click any point for its 3D structure. computational

Protein & de novo design

Designed metalloenzymes

One reaction, aromatic ring hydroxylation at a non-heme Fe(II) center, taken from a catalytic motif to scored scaffolds.

Backbones are generated with RFdiffusion3, sequenced with LigandMPNN, refolded with Boltz across seeds, then gated on whether the design rebuilds a catalytic 2-His-1-carboxylate site with the substrate in near-attack range. Of 29 designs, 1 cleared every gate. computational

Design landscape

Every scored design, by geometry score against how close the substrate sits to the metal.

score vs substrate distancehover
the funnel
  1. Build the site. retrieve a real motif, place the substrate
  2. Generate backbones. RFdiffusion3, about 6 s per design on one RTX 5090
  3. Design sequence. LigandMPNN with the ligand in context
  4. Refold. Boltz across seeds; must rebuild its own site
  5. Gate on geometry. donor distances, triad angles, near-attack
  6. Quantum chemistry. ORCA cluster optimization of the active site

Computational materials discovery

Simulation results

Selected results from a materials screening portfolio, each a computed quantity with its method and a reference point. computational

+5.1 %

Low-shrink vitrimer

Positive polymerization volume change for a spiro-orthoester monomer by GROMACS MD, against the shrinkage normal for acrylates. Force field validated to under 0.3 % on polymer density.

R² = 0.96

pH-switchable adhesive

Catechol-boronate binding tuned by substituent, a six-point Hammett series with slope -6.0 kcal/mol per sigma, cross-validated by three methods including DLPNO-CCSD(T).

214 °C

Lignin bio-epoxy

Predicted glass transition for a bio-based diglycidyl plus amine network by group additivity scaled to a measured benchmark; electronically a close match to the petrochemical reference.

0.70 eV

Ladder OECT polymer

Band gap of a benzimidazole-benzophenanthroline ladder by periodic DFT with a scaling correction, matching the measured 0.7 to 0.9 eV; polaron-stable for n-channel operation.

18 pts

Tunable-Tg polyphosphazene

An 18-point Hammett QSPR over aryloxide substituents, relating electronic descriptors to a target glass transition from 50 to 150 C on a UV-stable backbone.

~1 eV

Carborane siloxane

DFT strain analysis of boron-cage substitution, about 1 eV at 3 percent bond deformation, pointing to a higher service temperature through steric stiffening.

7,700

Super-glassy membrane

A PTMSP-type membrane screened by DFT on its repeat units, placed above the Robeson bound at an O2 permeability of 7,700 Barrer; the open question is arresting physical aging.

32

Masked cytokine scaffold

Thirty-two protease-masked cytokine backbones generated with RFdiffusion3 for tumor-selective activation. Early-stage design; receptor-face verification is the next gate.

Materials centerpiece

Protein nanocage platform

A platform for self-assembling protein nanocages, built for scale and for honest provenance over hundreds of thousands of files.

4EGGfull assembly

Reference architectures from the scaffold library, built out to their full biological assembly and colored by chain. Helices and sheets are solid; the per-residue beads are drawn translucent. Load 5IM5 for the largest, a full capsid of about 157,000 atoms. Designed shells and their coarse-grained whole-cage trajectories live in the private platform.

Scientific software & infrastructure

Instruments, not just repositories

The engineering behind the science, packaged and tested. The two marked ready are staged for release; the design engines stay private while the methods are unpublished.

polymer-engine

ready

Orchestration engine for polymer discovery over MD and QM, with provenance, active learning, and a multi-backend parameterization layer. 1016 tests.

github.com/Hun731/polymer-engine

orca-tools

ready

ORCA output parsing, Seminario force constants, and job-status triage. Reaction agnostic. 25 tests.

github.com/Hun731/orca-tools

foundry-studio

planned

Browser workbench for de novo design over RFdiffusion3, LigandMPNN, and Boltz, with an active-site builder, docking, and pocket detection.

packaging

planned

Property prediction with DFT validation in the loop for MOF linkers. Nine model families with cross-validation and SHAP.
